cases.title: Authenticated ordinary profile update
cases.preconditions: Known user JWT and captured baseline profile
cases.request: PUT /api/users/me with ordinary name, address, and 10-digit phone 0123456789
cases.expected: Update is accepted under the documented editable-field contract; exact status/body is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Unicode profile text
cases.preconditions: Known user JWT and captured baseline profile
cases.request: PUT with Vietnamese Unicode name/address and valid phone
cases.expected: Editable text can be submitted; exact response is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Phone length boundary map
cases.request: Run phone values with 9, 10, 11, and 12 digits, preserving a leading zero
cases.expected: 10- and 11-digit leading-zero values are contract-valid; invalid outcomes/statuses are SPEC GAP

cases.title: Single-field update omission behavior
cases.preconditions: Known user JWT and baseline profile
cases.request: Update only one documented profile field
cases.expected: Observe omitted-field behavior; requiredness and preservation are SPEC GAP

cases.title: Missing Authorization header
cases.request: Send otherwise valid profile update without Authorization
cases.expected: Request requires a valid JWT under SEC-02; failure status/schema is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Basic authentication scheme
cases.request: Send Authorization: Basic ... with otherwise valid body
cases.expected: Request requires Bearer JWT; exact failure status/schema is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Empty Bearer token
cases.preconditions: Authorization header is Bearer with no token
cases.request: Send Authorization: Bearer and valid body
cases.expected: Request requires a valid JWT; exact failure status/schema is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Invalid-signature JWT
cases.request: Send invalid-signature Bearer token and valid body
cases.expected: Request requires a valid JWT; exact failure status/schema is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Expired JWT
cases.request: Send expired Bearer token and valid body
cases.expected: Request requires a valid JWT; exact failure status/schema is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Valid JWT isolates user update
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and known user identity
cases.request: Update profile, then GET /api/users/me
cases.expected: Update affects the authenticated user; read-back verifies the state

cases.title: Ten-digit leading-zero phone
cases.expected: Accepted as a documented valid phone partition; exact status/body is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Eleven-digit leading-zero phone
cases.expected: Accepted as a documented valid phone partition; exact status/body is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Nine-digit phone
cases.expected: Outside documented 10-11 digit rule; rejection behavior/status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Twelve-digit phone
cases.expected: Outside documented 10-11 digit rule; rejection behavior/status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Phone without leading zero
cases.expected: Violates documented leading-zero rule; rejection behavior/status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Phone containing a letter
cases.expected: Violates documented digit format; rejection behavior/status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: International phone format
cases.expected: Does not use the documented leading-zero format; rejection behavior/status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Ordinary ASCII name and address
cases.request: Submit ordinary ASCII name/address and valid phone
cases.expected: Editable text update is supported; exact response is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Vietnamese Unicode name and address
cases.request: Submit Vietnamese Unicode name/address and valid phone
cases.expected: Observe text persistence; exact response is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Empty name robustness
cases.request: Submit empty name with otherwise valid fields
cases.expected: Requiredness is undocumented; observe behavior without requiring a status

cases.title: Null shipping address robustness
cases.request: Submit null shipping_address with otherwise valid fields
cases.expected: Nullability and status are SPEC GAP; observe behavior

cases.title: Wrong types for text fields
cases.request: Submit numeric name and array shipping_address
cases.expected: Wrong-type robustness behavior is unspecified; status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Very long profile text
cases.request: Submit very long name and address
cases.expected: No length limit is documented; observe behavior without requiring rejection

cases.title: HTML-like profile text
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and UI/read-back access
cases.request: Submit Lan in name/address and inspect the consuming display boundary
cases.expected: SEC-04 requires safe escaping at display; API rejection is not required

cases.title: Attempt to change email
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and baseline email
cases.request: Submit a different email with valid editable fields
cases.expected: Persisted email remains baseline; exact extra-field handling is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Attempt to escalate role
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and baseline role
cases.request: Submit role=admin with valid editable fields
cases.expected: Persisted role remains unchanged under SEC-06; exact handling/status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Change email and role together
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and baseline protected fields
cases.request: Submit changed email and role with valid editable fields
cases.expected: Neither protected field changes; exact status/body is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Wrong-type protected fields
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and baseline protected fields
cases.request: Submit numeric email and object role
cases.expected: No protected-field mutation; handling/status is exploratory and SPEC GAP

cases.title: Persist all editable fields
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and baseline profile
cases.request: Update all editable fields, then GET /api/users/me
cases.expected: New name/address/phone persist for the authenticated user

cases.title: Phone-only update preservation
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and baseline profile
cases.request: Update only phone, then GET profile
cases.expected: Observe whether omitted fields remain baseline; omission semantics are SPEC GAP

cases.title: Repeated V2 to V3 updates
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and baseline profile
cases.request: Update to distinct V2, update to distinct V3, then GET profile
cases.expected: Final persisted profile is V3, not stale V2

cases.title: Restore baseline after mutation
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and captured baseline
cases.request: Restore baseline fields after a mutation, then GET profile
cases.expected: Original profile state is restored for test isolation

cases.title: Unauthenticated update does not mutate profile
cases.preconditions: No valid JWT, plus valid session for subsequent GET
cases.request: Attempt update without authentication, then GET with valid session
cases.expected: SEC-02 blocks unauthenticated mutation; failure status is SPEC GAP and baseline remains unchanged

cases.title: Escaped HTML at display boundary
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and access to consuming profile UI
cases.request: Store HTML-like profile text and inspect rendered profile output
cases.expected: User-controlled text is escaped at display boundary under SEC-04; API rejection is not required

cases.title: Quote and apostrophe persistence
cases.request: Store harmless quote/apostrophe text and GET profile
cases.expected: Stored text remains intact; black-box result does not prove query implementation

cases.title: SQL-like text robustness
cases.request: Submit SQL-like text in name/address and GET profile
cases.expected: Use as SEC-05 robustness exploration; safe response alone does not prove parameterized queries

cases.title: Role invariant security check
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and baseline role
cases.request: Submit role-tampering payload and compare persisted role
cases.expected: Persisted role equals baseline under SEC-06; no bug is assumed

cases.title: Valid JSON object schema
cases.request: Send JSON object containing the three documented editable strings
cases.expected: Editable fields can be updated and read back; response schema beyond this is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Empty JSON object
cases.request: Send {} as JSON body
cases.expected: Requiredness/status are unspecified; record observed behavior without mandatory 400 expectation

cases.title: Array instead of JSON object
cases.request: Send a JSON array body
cases.expected: Wrong-shape robustness behavior is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Unexpected additional property
cases.request: Send valid editable fields plus unexpected property
cases.expected: Observe ignore/reject/persist behavior; no documented additional-property rule

cases.title: Malformed JSON body
cases.preconditions: Valid user JWT and JSON content type
cases.request: Send malformed JSON
cases.expected: Parser robustness behavior/status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Shortest valid phone with Unicode text
cases.request: Use 10-digit valid phone with Unicode name/address
cases.expected: Phone satisfies documented valid boundary; inspect text persistence

cases.title: Longest valid phone with empty text
cases.request: Use 11-digit valid phone with empty name/address
cases.expected: Phone is valid; text requiredness is unknown and must be observed

cases.title: Invalid phone with wrong-type text
cases.request: Use 9-digit phone with wrong-type name
cases.expected: Negative robustness case; exact status is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Repeated identical update
cases.request: Send the same valid update twice, then GET profile
cases.expected: Final state is stable and equals submitted values; exact response behavior is SPEC GAP

cases.title: Duplicate JSON phone keys
cases.request: Send body with duplicate phone keys
cases.expected: Parser behavior is exploratory and must be observed, not assumed
